title: Cross-Species Root Transcriptional Network Analysis Highlights Conserved Modules in Response to Nitrate between Maize and Sorghum
genotypes: B73 (maize); BTx623 (Sorghum bicolor, non-Zea, profiled in parallel)
stage_age: V3 (three-leaf stage) at onset of treatment
growth_system: coconut matrix (coir substrate) fertilized with modified Hoagland solution; 14/10 h light/dark; growth chamber vs greenhouse NR
N_treatments: pre-grown to V3 on DN 0.15 mM KNO3 (+14.85 mM KCl); then SN 15 mM KNO3 (treatment) vs NN 15 mM KCl (0 N control)
timepoints_duration: roots sampled 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 h after SN or NN supply
bio_reps: 1 per time point per treatment (each sample a pool of 3 plants)
n_libraries: 36 total (2 treatments x 2 species x 9 time points); 18 maize
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2500 (Hanyu Biotechnology); read layout NR
other_omics: DAP-seq (ZmNIGT1 binding sites); qRT-PCR; transient luciferase assays
key_finding: Maize-sorghum nitrate time-series WGCNA found 22 conserved modules; G2-like hub TFs ZmNIGT1/SbNIGT1 act as repressors
notes: No data-availability statement or accession found in PMC text; unreplicated design (one pooled sample per time point per treatment); reads mapped to B73 RefGen v3 (TopHat/Cufflinks)

title: Genome-wide identification and functional prediction of nitrogen-responsive intergenic and intronic long non-coding RNAs in maize (Zea mays L.)
stage_age: V7 (seven-leaf stage); N treatments applied from three-leaf stage
growth_system: plastic containers (20 x 20 x 40 cm) with 80% quartz sand + 20% vermiculite; greenhouse, Jiangsu Academy of Agricultural Sciences (Nanjing, China)
N_treatments: LN 0.15 mM vs SN 15 mM KNO3 in nutrient solution
timepoints_duration: N treatment from three-leaf stage to V7 (days NR); single sampling at V7
bio_reps: NR for RNA-seq (one SN and one LN dataset reported); 3 independent biological replicates used for qPCR validation only
n_libraries: NR (2 datasets reported: ~15 Gb SN, ~13 Gb LN)
platform_layout: rRNA-depleted (RiboMinus) total RNA-seq; Illumina HiSeq 2500, PE100 (Berry Genomics)
other_omics: leaf total N content; qPCR; co-expression network using public Affymetrix N-response microarray data (90 profiles; GEO ID not given in text)
key_finding: 7,245 intergenic/intronic lncRNAs identified; 637 N-responsive, mostly in an energy/oxidative-phosphorylation co-expression module
notes: lncRNA-focused total RNA-seq; RNA-seq appears unreplicated (check run count in SRP059655); reads mapped to B73 RefGen v3

title: Uncovering the early and conserved molecular mechanisms of root nitrogen foraging in model and crops
genotypes: B73 (maize); Arabidopsis Col-0 and tomato M82 / Heinz 1706 also profiled (non-Zea)
stage_age: seedlings: 4 d germination, 7 d in sand, 9 d hydroponics, root trimming + 2 d recovery, 2 d N starvation; sampled 8 h after split-root treatment
growth_system: hydroponic split-root (two equal crown roots in separate containers); growth room 14/10 h, 28/22 °C, 270-310 µmol m-2 s-1
N_treatments: pre-growth 0.25 mM Ca(NO3)2; 2 d N starvation; then C.NO3 (both halves 2 mM Ca(NO3)2), C.Cl (both halves 2 mM CaCl2), split Sp.NO3 (2 mM Ca(NO3)2) / Sp.Cl (2 mM CaCl2)
other_factors: none (cross-species comparison with Arabidopsis and tomato)
timepoints_duration: RNA at 8 h after split-root treatment (root phenotypes at 4 d)
bio_reps: 3 per condition (controls: pool of 3 seedlings; split: pool of 6 seedlings/roots)
n_libraries: 21 maize (computed: 4 root + 3 shoot conditions x 3 reps)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2500 v4, SE75, stranded (NEBNext Ultra II Directional); NYU GenCore
other_omics: root biomass and lateral root length phenotyping; Arabidopsis split-root RNA-seq time course (0-8 h, shoots and roots, PE100); tomato split-root RNA-seq (6 h, NovaSeq PE150)
key_finding: B73 shows split-root N foraging; systemic N-signal DEGs overlap significantly between maize and tomato but not Arabidopsis
notes: Data-availability statement not in PMC text and publisher page fetch refused (HTTP 429); maize DEGs: 661 Sp.NO3 vs C.NO3 roots, 10,248 Sp.Cl vs C.Cl roots; reference Zm-B73 v4; n_libraries computed from stated design

title: High-resolution profile of transcriptomes reveals a role of alternative splicing for modulating response to nitrogen in maize
growth_system: hydroponic culture (modified Hoagland); growth chamber vs greenhouse NR
N_treatments: grown 2 weeks under DN 0.15 mM KNO3 (SN 15 mM KNO3 used only for phenotype comparison; KCl balances K); N-starved DN roots sampled before vs 30 min after nitrate supply (resupply concentration NR)
timepoints_duration: 0 vs 30 min after nitrate supply (qPCR time course 0-240 min)
bio_reps: 3 per condition for Illumina; 1 PacBio library per condition
n_libraries: 6 Illumina + 2 PacBio Iso-Seq (1 SMRT cell each)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2500, PE150 (TruSeq Stranded); PacBio Sequel Iso-Seq
other_omics: PacBio full-length isoforms (alternative splicing); DAP-seq (ZmNLP6); transient transactivation assays; qPCR
key_finding: >1000 genes show nitrate-specific alternative splicing, mostly not DE; ZmNLP6 isoforms differ in target activation
notes: No data-availability statement or accession in PMC text (back matter not captured by tool); PacBio libraries made from the same RNA as RNA-seq; ~17-22 M fragments per Illumina sample; B73 v4

title: Model-to-crop conserved NUE Regulons enhance machine learning predictions of nitrogen use efficiency
tissue: seedling shoot; seedling root (separately); etiolated leaf protoplasts for TARGET assays
growth_system: paper-roll germination then nitrate-free MS hydroponic medium; Percival growth chamber (NYU), 16/8 h, 27/24 °C, 70% RH
N_treatments: 2 d N starvation, then +N (MS-level N: 20 mM KNO3 + 20 mM NH4NO3; 10% 15N-labelled) vs -N control (20 mM KCl)
timepoints_duration: 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120 min after transfer (sampling started 2 h after lights on)
bio_reps: 3 per time point per treatment (pool of 3 seedlings)
platform_layout: Lexogen QuantSeq 3' mRNA-seq with UMIs; Illumina NextSeq 500, SE75
other_omics: 15N uptake (IRMS); TARGET protoplast QuantSeq (+/-N, 2 h); ZmKN1 ChIP-seq; Arabidopsis TARGET RNA-seq; reanalysis of published maize N datasets; XGBoost NUE models
key_finding: Fine-scale N time course reveals maize-Arabidopsis conserved temporal N cascade; ZmMYB34/R3 NUE regulon improves NUE prediction
notes: Paper states accessions are listed in supplementary tables (not in PMC text); n_libraries not stated (design: 10 time points x 2 treatments x 2 tissues x 3 reps; handling of 0-min samples NR); N concentrations printed as '20 m[M]' in PMC text (mM consistent with MS medium); TARGET protoplast +/-N RNA-seq is additional cell-based N data

stage_age: 3-d-old germinated seedlings + 24 h -N pretreatment + 24 h treatment
growth_system: hydroponics (Hoagland, 50 mL); growth chamber 14/10 h, 25/18 °C, 280 µmol m-2 s-1

timepoints_duration: 24 h after transfer to treatments (single resupply time point)
bio_reps: 3 per condition (20 seedlings pooled each); only 2 kept for NO3- + cPTIO after QC

title: A multiple ion-uptake phenotyping platform reveals shared mechanisms affecting nutrient uptake by roots
genotypes: M162W; Ky21 (high specific nutrient uptake rate); CML69; CML227; CML228 (low); B73 (intermediate); all NAM founders
stage_age: seedlings: 4 d germination + 12 d full nutrient + 48 h deprivation
growth_system: aerated hydroponics (cone-tainers); growth chamber (Conviron E7/2), 16/8 h, 28/20 °C, 400 µmol m-2 s-1 PAR
N_treatments: full 0.5-strength modified Hoagland (5.7 mM KNO3 + 0.3 mM NH4NO3) vs 48 h macronutrient-free solution (no N, P, K, Mg, S; 0.5 mM CaCl2 + micronutrients)
other_factors: genotype (contrasting specific uptake rates); P, K, Mg and S withdrawn together with N
timepoints_duration: 48 h deprivation vs continued full nutrient; single sampling
bio_reps: 3 per line per treatment (2-3 plants pooled)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq (Novogene), PE150, TruSeq Stranded mRNA; 30-40 M reads
other_omics: multi-ion uptake kinetics (NO3-, NH4+, phosphate, K, sulfate; ion chromatography); root respiration; root/shoot morphology; RT-qPCR
key_finding: Specific uptake rates of NO3-, NH4+, K, P and S are heritable and correlated; high-uptake lines share deprivation-responsive genes
notes: CAUTION: N deprivation confounded with simultaneous removal of P, K, Mg and S (not an N-specific contrast); BioProject ID stated but hyperlink stripped from PMC text; n_libraries computed from stated design; B73 v4
